items.title: Why a Single Wire Report About Government Cash Sent AMD, Intel, and Micron Higher Overnight
items.summary: A single wire report about a government cash account nobody was watching sent AMD, Marvell, and Micron surging overnight, and the reason explains exactly why the same trade can unwind just as fast.

items.title: Nvidia Isn’t the Only Hero the Stock Market Needs Right Now
items.summary: Only time will tell which ends up being more exciting, but Nvidia has half a chance.  The artificial-intelligence trade, and chip stocks in particular, have faltered in recent weeks and need a timely boost from the world’s most valuable company.  Intuit  earnings have brought the sector more pain, reigniting fears over the impact of AI disruption.

items.title: United Steps Up Its Game in Competition for Jet-Setting US Travelers
items.summary: United plans its biggest network expansion ever in 2027 as America’s two most profitable airlines fight for Americans traveling overseas.

items.title: United Airlines Makes Bold International Move
items.summary: New routes could strengthen United's premium international growth engine

items.title: United Expands Long-Haul Network With 10 International Cities Routes
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings Inc. will add destinations in Europe and Asia to its network next year, using Airbus SE's new long-range narrow-body planes. The carrier will fly the A321XLR planes from its Newark hub to locations including Luxembourg and Marseille, and from San Francisco to Okinawa, Japan. Bloomberg's Siddharth Philip joins to discus.

items.title: Why United Airlines Is Doubling Down on Overseas Travel
items.summary: The carrier unveiled the largest international expansion in its history, added 10 new cities to its 2027 schedule.

items.title: United Airlines Ups Its Bet on Instagrammable International Destinations
items.summary: United Airlines  is readying its biggest-ever international expansion, betting that adding nonstop connections to far-flung, social media-friendly locales will keep passengers booking trips abroad.  The Chicago-based carrier on Tuesday announced new destinations ranging from Ljubljana, Slovenia and Marseille, France to Ibiza, Spain.  “People’s desire to see and explore the world is bigger and brighter than ever,” said  Scott Kirby,  United’s chief executive, at an event in Newark, N.J.

items.title: Archer Aviation vs. Joby Aviation: Which EV Aircraft Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Archer's airline partnerships and defense acquisitions clash with a staggering net losses, while Joby's vertically integrated model and Toyota backing come with equally massive burn.
